title_en: Supreme People's Court Notice on the Calculation Standard of Compensation for Infringement of Citizens' Right to Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2010
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Standard for Compensation to Be Applied in State Compensation Decisions Made in the Year 2010 Concerning the Infringement of Citizens' Right to Personal Freedom

Fa Fa [2010] No. 28

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where the personal freedom of a citizen is infringed upon, the daily compensation shall be calculated on the basis of the national average daily wage of the preceding year for employed workers."

Based on the average annual wage of employed workers in urban non-private units in 2009 (i.e., the former "national average annual wage of employed workers on duty") published by the National Bureau of Statistics on July 16, 2010, the average annual wage of employed workers in urban non-private units in 2009 is 32,736 yuan. According to the formula for calculating the average daily wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the standard average daily wage is 32,736 (yuan) ÷ 12 (months) ÷ 21.75 (monthly paid days) = 125.43 yuan. Accordingly, when making state compensation decisions in the year 2010, the people's courts at all levels shall apply a daily compensation of 125.43 yuan for the infringement of citizens' right to personal freedom.

This notice is hereby issued, and it shall be complied with.

July 16, 2010
